full_judgment: 46. These evidences go to show that the fact of contract, writing of the agreement, execution of the agreement, payment of consideration as stated in the plaint have been contradicted by all the witnesses leading to the presumption that the case of the plaintiff was founded upon bundles of falsehood. In view of the above, we are constrained to hold that no payment of consideration money was made by the plaintiff as alleged.
